summary: COSCIENS Biopharma Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, reporting results of its annual general meeting and the appointment of Peter H. Puccetti as permanent full-time President and CEO, effective immediately. Puccetti, previously Chairman and Interim CEO since November, will continue to strengthen operational performance and align resources with strategic priorities. Shareholders approved the re-election of directors, re-appointment of Deloitte LLP as auditors, and a Share Capital Amendment involving a 1:150 consolidation followed immediately by a 50:1 split (net effect: 1:3 split). The board supported both actions. No deal terms apply; the structural change is share consolidation and split. Watch for further details on the capital amendment execution timeline; risk-arb angle minimal.
